heard: Meteors fell across North America for nine hours straight. Eyewitnesses watched thousands of stars fall just like snow in 1833. Scientists then believed shooting stars were just weird atmospheric weather. But Yale Professor Dennis and Olmsted noticed something revolutionary about the storm. Every single meteor appeared to radiate from one specific point in Leo. Olmsted proved they're actually pieces of space rock, not weather. This one night proved Earth was flying through a cosmic debris field. modern meteor science exists today all because of that historic night.
